The `label` config object is two scalar attributes: label-position (start | top; defaults top for several columns, start otherwise) and label-width (a number is px, a string any CSS length) (METADATA-02).
`title` is a global attribute (A§7.1): `heading` attribute, or slot="heading" for rich content.

hooks.notes: Label position, orientation and column layout reach the items as inherited private custom properties (subgrid), so no context is needed (METADATA-03).

differences.text: Semantics decision: a native <dl> cannot own custom-element children (its <dt>/<dd> would have to be direct children in one tree, and an item cannot be both a term and a definition). The list is role=list on an inner element, each pair is a listitem host (ElementInternals), and each pair's label and value are role=term and role=definition, so a screen reader announces "list, N items" and each label with its value. Upstream rendered <dl>/<dt>/<dd>.

The `label` config object becomes the scalar attributes label-position and label-width (structured data is property-only, A§7.2, but this object is two scalars). `title` is `heading` because `title` is a global attribute.

Each pair is its own element with its own shadow root, so the grid is shared through subgrid: every pair spans the list's label and value tracks (or its own two tracks for side labels with `multi`). The list publishes --_span, --_item-columns and --_label-min as inherited private custom properties; there is no context. Side labels with `multi` lay each pair out in its own two tracks (upstream put label and value in separate cells of an auto-fill grid).

The collapse state is `expanded` (attribute = initial state) with a cancelable tct-open-change intent event when the user toggles it; upstream kept it as internal state with no callback. Items past the cap are marked data-tct-collapsed on the light-DOM children and hidden with display: none (so they leave the accessibility tree). The toggle labels are the upstream @tct.metadataList.showMore/showLess messages with show-more-label and show-less-label overrides.
The Show more toggle reads in --color-text-accent (the accent ink) because --color-accent is a fill in Tecton (tecton-astryx components.ts `metadata-list`, 2.2:1 otherwise).

requests.reason: The rule flags every `new Tct*()`, including the library event classes (`new TctOpenChangeEvent(...)`, which A§7.6 requires), so elements import them under an alias. Exclude class names ending in `Event`.

core.metadata-list.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] subgrid keeps labels aligned across independent items; [mwg:accessible-web-components] roles through ElementInternals, aria-controls within one root; [mwg:styling-web-components] inherited custom properties as the layout channel, ::slotted; [mwg:shadow-dom] slotchange.

api.reason: Any data-* attribute on the host is kept as authored.
A-xstyle: use class/style on the host, ::part(label) and ::part(value).

differences.text: The host is the pair's wrapper and the `astryx-metadata-list-item` target (style the tag itself; hosts carry no paint of their own); the label and value are parts `label` and `value`. See METADATA-01 for the term/definition semantics.
